desc: Redraw this sparrow as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic sparrow proportions, same face, brown cap, white cheeks, striped brown wings, blue bead necklace, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on cap and wings, subtle feather shading.
